title: Automated Logistics Invoice Processing
business: Logistics and supply chain firms managing thousands of vendor invoices.
problem: Manual data entry is prone to human error and high operational costs, leading to payment delays.
solution: Google Cloud Document AI uses specialized processors to classify incoming documents and extract structured information, automating the transition from raw PDF invoices to machine-readable data.
steps: Create a dedicated processor in the Document AI console for invoice parsing.
Upload raw invoice files to a designated Cloud Storage bucket.
Trigger a processing request to the Document AI API to extract fields like invoice number, date, and total amount.
Map the extracted JSON output to the internal accounting database schema.
Implement a validation workflow to flag low-confidence extractions for human review.
outcome: Increased operational efficiency and higher data accuracy in financial records.
limitation: The system may struggle with low-resolution or handwritten documents, which can be checked by monitoring the confidence score returned in the API response.
